BUG 3 — Dutch (nl) ordinal suffix: FIXED and verified.

ROOT CAUSE
/dayjs/src/locale/nl.js line 11 had `ordinal: n => `${n}.`` — the Dutch locale returned the day number plus a period (a German/Danish-style ordinal) instead of the Dutch suffix. `Do` is handled by src/plugin/advancedFormat/index.js, which calls `locale.ordinal(this.$D)`, so every `Do` in nl came out as "8.".
